headline: India's Gems and Jewellery Exports Jump 34% to ₹27,863 Crore in October
summary: India's gems and jewellery exports climbed 34% year-on-year to ₹27,863 crore in October, driven by robust festive demand for gold jewellery and synthetic stones.
why: Gems and jewellery represent one of India's top merchandise export sectors, generating vital foreign exchange and sustaining extensive domestic employment.

impacts.name: India Gems & Jewellery
impacts.why: A 34% surge in monthly export value reflects heightened international sourcing and festive shipments.
